papers.title: Occupancy Flow Fields for Motion Forecasting in Autonomous Driving
papers.paper_read: Main text and metric definitions; official metric implementation read in full
papers.license_scope: Apache-2.0 header in occupancy_flow_metrics.py; dataset license not inferred
verified_facts: Separate observed and occluded occupancy scores
PR-AUC uses 100 thresholds
Flow EPE masks exactly zero GT vectors
Flow-warped score requires predicted flow and GT origin occupancy
Pinned _flow_warp raises NotImplementedError because tensorflow-graphics dependency was deprecated
papers.research_inference: No native binary-only EPE for O; preserve occupancy domain instead of borrowing the flow validity mask

papers.title: Cam4DOcc: Benchmark for Camera-Only 4D Occupancy Forecasting in Autonomous Driving Applications
papers.paper_read: Sections III-A/B/C and flow appendix; metric utility code
verified_facts: GMO denotes movable semantic categories, not actual moving state
Future IoU and optional temporal weighting
Label preprocessing includes visibility/newborn conditions and missing-frame motion handling
Backward centripetal flow needs instance information and is not same physical point motion
papers.research_inference: Use geometry IoU without importing their data filtering as a posthoc change to the current evaluator

papers.title: OccWorld: Learning a 3D Occupancy World Model for Autonomous Driving
papers.paper_read: Paper experiment metrics section and official multi_step_MeanIou plus separate planning evaluator
verified_facts: Semantic and geometric IoU aggregated by horizon
Per-horizon TP, GT count and prediction count after ignore-label filtering
Planning L2/collision evaluates ego trajectory rather than other-object scene flow
papers.research_inference: Temporal averaging of occupancy IoU does not identify temporal correspondence

papers.title: UniOcc: A Unified Benchmark for Occupancy Forecasting and Prediction in Autonomous Driving
papers.paper_read: Sections 3.4/3.5, public uniocc_eval.py and uniocc_track.py interfaces; not the 2023 same-name occupancy model
verified_facts: Shape plausibility, temporal shape consistency and static consistency complement IoU
Public temporal tracker interface takes flow
Shape evaluation removes centroid and PCA rotation
Public reference temporal loop tests len on items() tuples, skipping those blocks
Static consistency evaluates overlapping transformed FOV
papers.research_inference: Shape consistency can remain high for wrong positions; current public reference is not an executable, flow-free physical-displacement benchmark
unknowns: No claim that the published paper used the exact defective public example; author clarification needed before reproducing it

papers.title: Point Cloud Forecasting as a Proxy for 4D Occupancy Forecasting
papers.paper_read: Paper section 4 equations and section 5.2, author evaluation.py and generate_query_rays.py
verified_facts: Queries provide future ray origin and direction; prediction provides depth
Depth L1/AbsRel and symmetric nearest-neighbor point-cloud distance
Near-field ROI [-70,-70,-4.5,70,70,4.5] and either empty set returns 0 in released evaluator
Query generation uses every fifth ray, drop_last=True, and only 3s loop despite two available loaders
papers.research_inference: Depth and Chamfer are future geometry, not correspondence; binary GMO cannot supply full physical first-return occupancy

read_boundaries: Official code was read, not installed or executed as a benchmark
One later public-source utility fetch timed out; no additional claim based on the missing read
Repository version and software license do not authorize unrestricted use of the associated dataset
No quantitative candidate result was inferred from literature
